positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend and midtier services for Google's measurement products:

* Google Tag Manger
* Google Marketing Platform and Integration Center
* Google Analytics

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer, I try to make it as easy as possible to integrate with Genability’s products. My main responsibilities include development of our core APIs, maintenance of client libraries, and curating our API documentation. I also work directly with our customers’ software engineers to help them incorporate our API into their tools and processes.

* Implemented Continuous Integration using Jenkins CI
* Created internal website to track which version of each project was deployed to a particular ElasticBeanstalk environment
* Designed and implemented new Solar (and other) Incentives API

positions.title: Sales Analyst
positions.description:
* Developed plug-in for Google Sketchup using Ruby and Ruby native extensions (C
programming language) to simplify PV layout process

* Developed sales pipeline database that integrated with our existing technical analysis platform (SIMS) in order to keep our sales pipeline permanently up-to-date

positions.title: Financial Analyst
positions.description:
* Led financial asset management for existing projects, including creation of new tools and processes in support of that effort

* Developed internal marketing tool to analyze the California public school solar market, determining total market size, best target areas, and potential market segments

* Developed and presented company valuation models to potential investors

* Developed new financial models in Excel to help the company understand potential deal structures for future projects

* Used Excel models to determine financial viability of prospective solar PV projects

positions.title: Energy Analyst
positions.description:
* Through development of new tools, multiplied Sales bandwidth 12x

* Co-managed third-party software development of Solar Investment Management System, which integrates project data from all stages (sales, design, construction, and system operations) of PV system lifecycle

* Drove the company to a better understanding of California utilities’ rate-setting and billing processes, dramatically changing the way that projects were chosen, designed, and implemented

* Analyzed and implemented the first “Virtual Net Metering” PV project in California

* Met with existing clients after system installation to review actual savings derived from installation of solar power system and discuss ways to maximize total benefit of going solar

* Managed a number of interns and contract employees in Design and Engineering group

projects.title: 10+ MW at Hart School District, the County of Orange, and others
projects.description:
The "Apple 1" portfolio consists of 10.7 MW across 5 projects and 18 sites. It was commissioned between October and December 2012.

My role in the project was multi-faceted. As with prior projects, I played a major role in the Energy Analysis (especially with respect to energy cost savings) for the project. I also have an ongoing role in the asset management of the project, which includes:

* Development of an Excel tool to streamline financial management of the project
* Quarterly payment of sale-leaseback rents and other vendor costs (e.g. O&M)
* Coordination and management of various O&M activities, especially reporting
* Communicating with clients re: performance of their systems
